[SWS_DM_01317] Realization of TransferData (0x36) in context of Re- questFileTransfer
⌈
If a TransferData (0x36) in context of RequestFileTransfer is re-
ceived, the Diagnostic Server instance shall call (depending on the data di-
rection read/write) the corresponding Read or Write methods of the handler classes
registered via the template constructors of DataTransferReadSession or DataTransfer-
WriteSession.
⌋
